Q: What citation style should I follow in UK nursing assignments?

UK universities generally require the use of APA, 7th edition, or the Harvard style referencing in nursing assignments. To make sure that it is being done right:

  • Go through your module handbook for guidelines
  • Go for citation software, such as Zotero, EndNote, or Mendeley
  • Maintain consistency across in-text citations and reference lists
  • Ensure that sources are reputable, traceable, and correctly formatted
  • Well constructed reference end your assignment into it.


    • Failure to reference correctly would be a possible cause for plagiarism.
